cues.en: But it's also a definition of the dot product.

cues.en: So it is the sum of element wise multiplications between all the individual elements in vector a and vector b.
cues.zh: 就是向量 a 和向量 b 的所有對應元素，逐一相乘後再相加。

cues.en: And then sum over all of the pairs of individual multiplications.
cues.zh: 再把每一對相乘的結果全部加起來。

cues.en: So the dot product between vector v and vector w is one times two plus zero times eight plus two times
